shots.purpose: introduce Maria before the pain point
shots.start_state: Maria is walking home from work on a Brazilian residential street at dusk
shots.end_state: Maria is closer to camera and still walking steadily toward home
shots.subject_action: Maria walks home carrying one brown work bag
shots.focal_point: Maria's face, age, and tired but capable presence

shots.purpose: show the weight of Maria arriving home
shots.start_state: front door closed; Maria outside with keys and work bag
shots.end_state: Maria inside; keys resting on the table
shots.subject_action: Maria enters and drops one set of keys
shots.focal_point: Maria's tired arrival and the keys

shots.start_state: Maria stands between the kitchen and dining area with phone lowered
shots.end_state: Maria holds the phone and settles into a resigned look
shots.subject_action: Maria looks from the phone to the stove
shots.camera_move: slow push from medium to close

shots.start_state: phone lowered with screen turned away
shots.end_state: voice note recorded and phone held steady
shots.subject_action: Maria raises the phone and records one voice note

shots.purpose: show the future delivery outcome without implying current commerce
shots.start_state: apartment door closed; courier outside with one bag
shots.subject_action: Maria accepts one unbranded delivery bag

shots.end_state: Maria finishes one bite and exhales
shots.subject_action: Maria takes one bite of salmon
